name: Neon Testament
source: Hundreds of universes merged into one when the Gods decided to finally settle who among them is the greatest and who must vanish. The main character, nicknamed Black, finds himself at the center of unbelievable events after the Ancient and Terrifying One saw something in him and chose this unremarkable guy as a "character" in the Gods' role-playing Game.
